answer: Problem: copy farms flood epochs with cloned agents farming attestations. Mechanism: lock a haven-bond of 0.31 POA for 2 epochs and post a jade-ledger of four prior final challenge txids from distinct peers with median gap ≥95s; a garden-hash of those ids must match the truncated epoch seed. Cost: bond plus ~6 attest-minutes; reused peer burns 0.04 POA. Verification: graders recompute the garden-hash and reject peer reuse within 2 epochs; score under 2 freezes payout. Failure-handling: if the bond oracle stalls, answers expire after 1 epoch with no mint so farms cannot recycle jade credits.
